freeFirstTurn.text:
To determine what you need on the final exam to achieve an A-, you can use the `calculator` function. The `calculator` function evaluates an arithmetic expression and returns the numeric result. If the result is 90 or higher, it indicates an A-. If the result is less than 90, it indicates a failing grade.

Here's how you can use the `calculator` function:

```xml
<tools>
  <function name="calculator" arguments="{"expression":"90 * (60 / 10)"}</function>
</tools>
```

This will evaluate the expression `90 * (60 / 10)`, which is `90 * 6 = 540`. Since 540 is greater than 90, the result is 90, which is the passing grade. Therefore, to get an A-, you need to score 90 or higher on the final exam.

notes: Token positions (pos) are the same as in hero-trace.json (checked against its token ids).

votePositions: pos 324 is the highest-entropy WORD in the reply. The closing <|im_end|> at pos 328 is higher overall (H=1.85: stop p=0.35 vs ' The' p=0.29); it was not used because it is a stop-or-continue choice, not a word choice.

votePositions: 'top' holds the exact top-500 logits; 'tail' bins every other real vocab row (151665 rows) by logit, width 0.5, bin center in 'logit'. 271 unused padding rows (ids >= 151665, the tokenizer's real size) were dropped; at these positions they hold < 3e-6 of the probability at T=1. Top-500 + binned tail reproduces the exact softmax of the top-500 entries to within 1.5e-03 (worst: pos 313 at T=0.7). Tail mass outside the top-500 at worst position: T=0.7 0.000, T=1.0 0.002, T=1.5 0.211, T=2.0 0.694.
votePositions.chosen.prob and all other probabilities in this file are softmax at T=1 over the 151665 real vocab rows (padding rows excluded).

context strings: visible text before the position with template markers (special tokens, role names, <tool_call> tags, <tool_response> wrappers) removed; a turn boundary becomes one '\n'. Cut to ~N characters at a word start.

temperatureRuns: context = hero tokens 0..308 (through the generation prompt '<|im_start|>assistant\n' after </tool_response>). Pure temperature sampling (no top-k, no top-p) over the 151665 real vocab rows, torch.multinomial with torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed); T=0 is greedy and has seed null. Max 40 new tokens; stops at <|im_end|> or <|endoftext|> (Qwen's two EOS ids), and the stop token is not included in text/tokens. A token that is part of a multi-byte character decodes to '\ufffd' on its own; 'text' is decoded as a whole.

freeFirstTurn: greedy, context = hero tokens 0..248 (tools available), max 260 new tokens, stop at <|im_end|>. usedTool = the text contains a real '<tool_call>' token; mentionsCalculator = the word 'calculator' appears at all (the model may describe or fake a call in the wrong syntax). finalNumberMentioned = the last number in the generated text (null if none). pToolCallStart / toolCallStartRank = the model's probability and rank for '<tool_call>' as the first token. withCalculatorInstruction appends ' Use the calculator tool for any arithmetic.' to the system prompt (its context is 257 tokens).

All generation in this file is PURE greedy/temperature sampling: no repetition penalty, top-k or top-p. Qwen's generation_config.json defaults to repetition_penalty=1.1, temperature=0.7, top_p=0.8, top_k=20, and HF generate() applies the repetition penalty even when do_sample=False. That is why the greedy reply quoted in hero-trace.json's notes says 'To achieve' while pure greedy says 'To get' (p=0.440 vs 0.426 after 'To').

beat.sentences: computed on the plain prefix text with NO chat template and no BOS token (Qwen adds none). truthProb multiplies the probabilities of all of the truth word's tokens (teacher-forced); truthRank is the rank of its first token. All lines are verbatim from public-domain texts. The Darwin prefix starts mid-sentence, as in the original's final sentence.
beat.thinkLike: 'kind' is the curation intent (easy / medium / open / wrong). truthProb and truthRank are extra fields beyond the request.
